bio: I'm a PhD Research Fellow in Computer Science at NTNU, where I research privacy-preserving computation — specifically fully homomorphic encryption (FHE), which lets you compute directly on encrypted data without ever decrypting it. I'm also the founder of Raven Labs AS, and a proactive learner drawn to fast-moving fields like AI and Web3.

Before starting the PhD in August 2026, I completed an MSc in Computer Science (AI) at NTNU with a thesis on the Visual Mamba (ViM) architecture. My other work spans building an AI pipeline that turns natural-language prompts into BigQuery queries at Sticos, leading a small intern team through a production web rebuild at Bouvet, and teaching and mentoring at NTNU since 2023 — including as an Education Mentor supporting a student's academic path in computer science, AI and mathematics. I value clear communication and building things that actually get used.

certs.name: PhD Computer Science (Privacy-Preserving Encryption), NTNU — in progress
